tenders.title: Forward Procurement Notice - The Wave Stage 3 (Metro) - Fleet, Operations & Maintenance Package
tenders.businessName: Department of Transport and Main Roads-North Coast
tenders.details:
This Forward Procurement Notice (FPN) is issued by the Department of Transport and Main Roads, on behalf of the Chief Executive (TMR) to publicly notify the market that TMR intends to commence an Invitation to Offer process for the Fleet, Operations and Maintenance (FOM) Package of The Wave Stage 3 (Metro) in the coming weeks.

This FPN provides prospective participants with preliminary information to assist in preparing for the proposed FOM Procurement Process. It does not constitute a formal market approach and does not obligate TMR to proceed with any procurement process associated with the FOM Package or The Wave Stage 3 (Metro).

Please refer to the attached Forward Procurement Notice document for further information.

  • All queries are to be addressed to TransactionNCRMajors@tmr.qld.gov.au. Any queries raised via VendorPanel will not be answered.
  • A response to this Forward Procurement Notice is NOT required.

tenders.title: UniSQ Servicing of Electrical, Mechanical and Electro-Mechanical Infrastructure
tenders.details: The University requires the services of a contractor to support maintenance of its electrical, mechanical, and electro-mechanical infrastructure at the Toowoomba, Ipswich, and Springfield campuses, as well as two smaller satellite sites. The works include planned predictive and reactive maintenance, as well as corrective and reactive maintenance.

tenders.title: Supply of Performance Health Practitioner Services (Nutrition) - Swimming (Gold Coast)
tenders.details:
Suppliers are invited by the Customer to submit an offer for Invitation to Offer No. 25DTS018B-NUTR (ITO16) for the provision of sport nutrition support.

The Contractor will provide sport nutrition support to categorised podium, developing and emerging athletes in the QAS Swimming program. The contractor will also be responsible for developing strategies to support exceptional High-Performance outcomes. Services will primarily be conducted from Gold Coast Aquatic Centre.

The services are to be provided for the equivalent of 1.5 days per week, which may be scheduled flexibly to meet program and athlete requirements. Services shall be provided for 48 weeks in each 12-month period.

The proposed contract term is from November 2026 to 25 February 2029.

The Contract Price will be based on a negotiated daily rate between $560 and $640 (excluding GST), depending on the successful Supplier's qualifications and experience. The daily rate is based on an 8-hour working day, and payment will only be made for days on which services are delivered. No payment will be made for public holidays or periods when the Supplier is unavailable (e.g. due to leave or illness).

Responses are sought from individual practitioner/s who have the appropriate qualifications, experience, expertise and capacity to provide the required services.
